allowed: The explicit x/y/z rotation gauge algebra passed internal group-action fixtures.
On the R1.12-derived development corpus, prefix gauge identification was unique on 130/130 ordinary-FB eligible routes and transported in-span two-block completion was observed on 120/130.
No-rotation routes completed at 117/124, while the preregistered rotation-present stratum completed at 3/6 and failed its 0.75 gate.
The 120 admitted development routes support a zero-fallback, nested attempt-level null bank with 1% empirical resolution.
A general move-level center-cocycle treatment of wide/slice moves was strongly rejected in posthoc diagnostics.
G3 is remanded and motivates a prospective canonical-Roux versus residual reconstruction-consistency ontology court.
prohibited: Roux cognitive recovery or error prevalence
calling 120/130 a fresh or confirmatory G3 validation
releasing Roux future scoring authority from R1.13
declaring the ten residual routes invalid or non-Roux without a separate prospective ontology/reconstruction-consistency court
